rungs.title: Social Media Assistant
rungs.summary: Learning the brand voice, the platforms and the approval flow.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the brand voice, each platform's norms and the approval flow.
rungs.delivery: Schedules and posts approved content and monitors replies.
rungs.leadership: Escalates tricky comments quickly and keeps the calendar honest.

rungs.title: Social Media Manager
rungs.summary: Runs the social channels, calendar and community.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in platform mechanics, paid basics and community policy.
rungs.delivery: Plans and runs the content calendar and reports what worked.
rungs.leadership: Handles the community with calm and works with design and content.

rungs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
rungs.summary: Owns social strategy and paid-social results.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in paid social, audience and measurement; uses AI tools well.
rungs.delivery: Owns social strategy and its results against a budget.
rungs.leadership: Mentors and manages crises; builds relationships with partners and creators.

rungs.title: Head of Social
rungs.summary: Sets social strategy and owns the brand's public voice.
rungs.knowledge: Connects social to brand, pipeline and risk.
rungs.delivery: Owns social strategy, budget and results.
rungs.leadership: Leads a team and speaks for the brand in public.
